main_measure.name: slope of excess forward 10-bar log return on forecast, short-bar non-overlapping blocks
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= +2 (with mean excess < 0 and higher decline share) confirms; t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: decline share on short blocks minus decline share on all blocks

decided_by: Slope t-statistic lies between -2 and +2, which the plan defines as inconclusive.
reading: Situation taken as raw SMA200 distance < 0 with forecast < 0; baseline is the mean forward 10-bar log return over every bar with a valid in-window forward return; short blocks are grid bars (positions 0,10,20,... per window) with forecast < 0 and the regression uses forecast as x; the plan's minimum of 15 short blocks is applied as 'not observable'.
